chore: migrate toast module to Typescript (#14890)

This PR converts our `toast` module to Typescript, adding appropriate types along the way. This continues !14508's scoped approach to tightening our frontend type-checks, in line with the feedback in https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/5859#issuecomment-2560264.

Reviewed-on: https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14890
Reviewed-by: Gu

git(mirror): silently ignore non-agit PR deletion instead of failing (#14901)

Oversight of #13661, discovered will working on !14885.

A `git push --mirror` will try to delete all `refs/pull/.../head` references, not only the Agit ones.
Adjust the code to silently ignore all PR deletion attempts.

Reviewed-on: https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14901
